full.description: This is an electron micrograph showing ultrastructural details of brain tissue. The image displays cellular structures, including cell nuclei and cytoplasmic organelles such as mitochondria and various vesicular components. The features visible are characteristic of a medulloblastoma. These findings help illustrate the fine structural morphology of this type of brain tumor.

random.description: This is an electron micrograph showing ultrastructural details of cellular changes, likely from a renal tissue sample. The image illustrates a lymphocyte or mononuclear inflammatory cell demonstrating apoptotic changes, characterized by chromatin condensation (pyknosis) and nuclear fragmentation. These features are commonly observed in kidney acute transplant rejection. The damaged cellular organelles and condensed nuclear material indicate active immune-mediated cellular destruction.
